content.comment_body: I am interested in using [product_name] for managing 16 projector screens (with simple UP and DOWN relay logic). Is it possible to set up web-based control for the entire system without much hassle? The [product_name] with [version_no] includes an Ethernet port and a web server, but it seems that the web server cannot be customized. Ideally, I want to send a simple UDP message or a RESTful API request from my web page to all [product_name] units to control the screens together. Thanks!

You might consider using a Raspberry Pi and Node-RED. With Modbus-TCP you could treat [product_name] [article_no] as a remote I/O device. Node-RED lets you build a user-friendly web interface for your controls quite easily.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to manage multiple devices via a web interface using [product_name] [version_no], but finds the built-in web server lacks customization and support for modern protocols like UDP or REST API. Feedback suggests these limitations may require integrating with external solutions to provide the desired web-based control. There is a clear need for more flexible and advanced automation integration than what is available by default.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects easy and flexible web-based control that would support UDP or RESTful API for triggering batch actions across devices. They are looking for a straightforward solution for controlling multiple units in their setup.
